Runtime sources from Ephemeral 0.3.0, upstream github.com/rodriveracom/ephemeral at main commit c250ba20fd67689df71a6b4ba563594ae1c21c73 (no v0.3.0 tag existed when this copy was taken). This replaces the pre-release candidate, whose StartOnce request fingerprint format differs from the release. Two adjustments are made to the runtime sources: the module path in go.mod is `ephemeral`, and sqlite_portable.go drops its !cgo build constraint, because OpenAgentInbox selects its portable modernc SQLite backend for all builds, including race-enabled builds. LICENSE is the upstream MIT license. Replace this directory with a require of the tagged module and drop the replace in go.mod once the tag exists.
